newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Every second Swede supports EMU membership - poll.
newsitem.headline: Every second Swede supports EMU membership - poll.

text.p: Opposition to joining Europe's monetary union is falling in Sweden, with every second Swede now supporting participation, a poll published on Tuesday showed.

The number of Swedes opposing EMU fell to 35 percent in May from 37 percent in an earlier poll in March. The survey was comissioned by JP Bank and daily Finanstidningen and carried out by pollster Sifo.

Of the 50 percent in favour of membership, 26 percent want Sweden to join from the start in 1999, up from 24 percent in March, while 24 percent want to wait, unchanged from the previous month. Fifteen percent were undecided in the May poll.
Among the ruling Social Democrats support for EMU is declining, down to 44 percent in May from 47 percent in March.
